content: The results from Table TABREF17 suggest that in general gated orthogonalization model performs better than the basic seq2seq model. Additionally, annotators were asked to verify if the generated summaries look natural (i.e, as if they were generated by humans). In 423 out of 500 cases, the annotators said “Yes” suggesting that gated orthogonalization model indeed produces good descriptions.
